title: UPDATE: Cloudflare Integrates Clef AI Into SGLang for Sub-40 ms Latency

tickers.name: Cloudflare, Inc. Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share

summary:
Developers can now access the Clef family of decision models via the /v1/systemone API after a technical integration with the SGLang framework. Cloudflare contributed upstream performance optimizations that enable sub-40 ms decision latency for its Clef-Flash model on a single H200 GPU and allow as many as 64 questions to be answered in one prefill. The company is currently preparing to add support for its multimodal Clef-Omni model to the API.

This availability expands a broader update to Cloudflare's AI suite, which includes a 27B parameter decision model and a native multimodal pipeline in Clef-Omni for processing audio, video, and images. The company recently doubled inference speeds for the family and cut the price of the Clef-Flash model to $0.038 per million input tokens. Internal teams already use these models to identify personally identifiable information and detect malicious domains.

selectedTweets.text:
Very proud to see @Cloudflare serving Clef with SGLang! Now available through SGLang’s existing /v1/systemone API.

The team also contributed Clef support and performance optimizations upstream to SGLang with:
· Validated against the official reference implementation
· Sub-40 ms decision latency for Clef-Flash on a single H200
· 64 questions answered in one prefill, with text and image support

Clef-Omni support is up next!
